services.desc: 从前期策划到正式运营，为您提供专业、透明且全程无忧的技术服务。

planlama.title: Planning
planlama.desc: The success of every waterpark project begins with correct planning. Investor budget, land structure, target audience, and market dynamics are analyzed to design the most suitable layout plan and concept.

tasarim.title: Design
tasarim.desc: We create exciting waterpark concepts with innovative and unique designs. Using 3D modeling technologies, we present the closest representation of what the project will look like when completed.

muhendislik.title: Engineering
muhendislik.desc: We design safe and durable structures in compliance with international standards. Structural analyses of steel construction and GRP (fiberglass) parts are conducted to ensure the highest safety and quality standards.

montaj.title: Installation & Assembly
montaj.desc: We complete site installations of projects as quickly as possible and smoothly with our expert assembly teams and site managers. We ensure full compliance with occupational health and safety rules.

bakim.title: Maintenance & Repair
bakim.desc: We offer regular maintenance services for waterparks to operate long-lastingly and safely. Pre-season checks, parts replacement, and technical support guarantee uninterrupted fun.

yenileme.title: Renovation
yenileme.desc: We renovate existing waterparks with modern technologies and trendy designs. By adding new slides, kids play groups, and themed elements, we boost the attraction of the parks.

step1.title: Product Design & Theming
step1.desc: Water slides, children's play groups, and water park attractions are custom designed according to the project concept and customer expectations. Color, pattern, theme, and visual details are developed in harmony with the product geometry to create unique designs that enhance the visitor experience.

step2.title: Engineering & Projecting
step2.desc: Slide systems, steel support structures, mechanical and hydraulic infrastructures are projected in detail by engineering teams. Structural calculations, technical analyses, production drawings, and assembly documents are prepared in accordance with the project conditions.

step3.title: Production
step3.desc: Fiberglass slide parts, steel constructions, models, molds, and project-specific components are prepared in Polgün's production facilities. Production processes are carried out based on dimensional accuracy, surface quality, durability, and traceability.

step4.title: Project Management & Shipping
step4.desc: Design, production, packaging, logistics, and field processes are coordinated according to the project calendar. Products are prepared with correct coding and labeling systems, securely packaged, and delivered to the project site complete.

step5.title: Montage & Commissioning
step5.desc: Slides, steel constructions, and related equipment are assembled by experienced field teams or under Polgün's technical supervision. After assembly, connections, sliding surfaces, water flow, and system functions are checked in detail.

planning.title: 产品设计与主题化包装
planning.desc: 提供概念规划、3D 渲染表现与符合当地文化特色的定制主题设计。

pirate_theme.desc: Polgün's signature theme, the Pirate Theme, is designed for children to sail in open seas full of pirates and have fun in this imaginary world.

underwater_theme.desc: An interactive playground designed based on colorful corals and different species waiting to be discovered, sparking children's curiosity about the underwater world.

navatu.sub: IAAPA Brass Ring Award-Winning Wave System
navatu.desc: Navatu is an innovative waterpark system developed at Polgün's R&D Center and awarded the Brass Ring award at IAAPA Expo Orlando. It takes the natural wave experience to a new dimension.

savana.desc: An innovative R&D project that combines four different slide paths in a single body. Savana offers its users a unique visual feast and sliding experience.

big_hole.desc: Big Hole is a large-scale enclosed water slide designed to offer a shared family rafting experience. Its wide-section tube structure delivers an impressive sense of speed and movement, turning the classic enclosed slide concept into a fun, social, and unforgettable family adventure.

big_raft.desc: Big Raft is a wide and comfortable family slide designed for shared use. Thanks to its wide sliding surface, families and groups of friends can experience speed and excitement together, combining social interaction with a delightful waterpark experience.

family_slide.desc: Family Slide is a multi-person raft slide designed for families and groups to enjoy together. With its wide turns, smooth transitions, and rafts accommodating up to four people, it offers interactive fun and high-capacity entertainment.

family_tornado.desc: Family Tornado brings the iconic funnel experience on a larger scale, allowing larger groups to experience the thrill together. Its wide funnel structure and strong oscillation movement offer high acceleration and an instantaneous feeling of weightlessness.

mid_hole.desc: Mid Hole is an enclosed family-type water slide offering a wide and impressive riding experience. The enclosed tube design increases the sense of mystery and excitement throughout the journey, providing a comfortable and shared sliding experience.

ufo_slide.desc: UFO Slide is a family-friendly raft water slide inspired by its unique elliptical form. The enclosed tube structure offers a smooth and comfortable slide for up to four riders, combining shared fun with high entertainment value.

freefall.desc: Freefall is a high-adrenaline water slide designed to deliver the intense sensation of free fall. With its nearly vertical drop angle and continuous high-speed track, it offers a short but extremely impressive sliding experience.

hydro_river.desc: Hydro River is an action-packed water slide that simulates a wild river adventure. Combining high-speed water currents, sharp turns, and sudden drops, it provides an exhilarating rafting experience for thrill-seekers.

rocket_slide.desc: Rocket Slide is a high-speed capsule slide that launches riders with a trapdoor start. Delivering maximum acceleration and speed, it offers a thrilling gravity-defying ride for adrenaline lovers.

uphill_slide.desc: Uphill Slide uses advanced water propulsion technology to push riders uphill against gravity. With its dynamic roller-coaster-like ups and downs, it delivers an innovative and exciting slide experience.

kamikaze.desc: Kamikaze is a classic high-speed speed slide offering multiple drops and intense acceleration. Designed for thrill-seekers, it provides an adrenaline-pumping sliding experience with a clear view of the descent.

babochka.desc: Babochka is a double-wing butterfly slide offering high-speed drops and bidirectional sliding action. With its unique wing-like geometry, it delivers a thrilling oscillation experience for riders.

boomerango.desc: Boomerango is a high-thrill slide that drops riders down a steep launch path before sending them high up a vertical wall. After experiencing temporary weightlessness at the peak, riders slide backward into a splash pool.

drone.desc: Drone Slide features a futuristic, enclosed design that combines light effects and sharp curves. It offers an interactive and mysterious journey, simulating a high-tech drone flight.

magic_tray.desc: Magic Tray is a wide-section circular bowl slide that spins riders around its perimeter before dropping them through the center hole into a splash pool below.

mini_boomerango.desc: Mini Boomerango brings the popular vertical wall experience on a smaller scale, making it accessible and fun for younger adventurers and families.

space_rocket.desc: Space Rocket is a high-speed slide featuring a launch capsule and a loop path, delivering high G-forces and maximum thrill for extreme sports enthusiasts.

super_bowl.desc: Super Bowl spins riders around a massive circular bowl before dropping them through a central exit, creating a suspenseful and highly entertaining slide experience.

space_bowl.desc: Space Bowl combines an enclosed tube entry with a giant open bowl spin, offering a thrilling combination of speed and centrifugal force.

tornado_slide.desc: Tornado Slide features a massive funnel that sucks rafts in, tossing them from side to side in a high-speed spiral before exiting into the splash pool.

planeta.desc: Planeta is a themed multi-sensory slide combining visual projections, sound effects, and unique slide paths to create an out-of-this-world journey.

body_racer.desc: Body Racer is a head-first mat racing slide with side-by-side lanes, allowing friends and family to compete in a high-speed dash to the finish line.

multi_slide.desc: Multi Slide features multiple parallel lanes for side-by-side racing, offering high capacity and competitive fun for waterpark visitors.

twister_slide.desc: Twister Slide consists of interlocking, twisting tubes that create a dizzying and fast-paced sliding experience.

racer_slide.desc: Racer Slide is a competitive racing slide featuring enclosed loops and open racing lanes, allowing riders to track their positions throughout the race.

spider_slide.desc: Spider Slide features a multi-legged design with branching slide paths, offering a mysterious and unique descent.

aquatube.desc: Aquatube is a classic high-speed enclosed tube slide, offering a fast and smooth ride in total darkness or with translucent color rings.

black_hole.desc: Black Hole is a popular enclosed slide featuring spectacular light and sound effects inside the dark tube, creating a sensory-rich adventure.

compact_slide.desc: Compact Slide is a space-saving water slide featuring tight curves and quick drops, perfect for smaller parks or hotel pools.

rafting_slide.desc: Rafting Slide offers a classic, moderate-speed open slide experience for single or double rafts, simulating a gentle river rafting trip.

wide_slide.desc: Wide Slide features a broad, open lane that allows multiple riders to slide side-by-side without rafts, offering safe and simple fun for families.

body_slide.desc: Body Slide is a classic open-air body slide featuring smooth curves and gentle drops, providing a fun and relaxing ride for all ages.

slip_fly.desc: Slip & Fly features a ramp at the end of the slide that launches riders into the air before landing in a deep pool. It offers a spectacular, high-action attraction that is as fun to watch as it is to ride.

canyon_slide.desc: Canyon Slide simulates a rafting journey through deep rocky canyons. With its high walls, sudden turns, and varied water flow, it offers an immersive and adventurous sliding experience for all ages.

crazy_cone.desc: Crazy Cone features one or more conical shapes that create sudden swings and directional changes. As rafts enter the cone, they oscillate high on the walls before exiting back into the slide tube.

hill_slide.desc: Hill Slide is a multi-bump slide that simulates a series of small hills, creating exciting airtime moments and speed variations throughout the descent.

hydra_slide.desc: Hydra Slide features a multi-lane design with twisting paths, allowing multiple riders to slide simultaneously and race to the finish line.

products.not_found_title: Didn't find what you were looking for?
products.not_found_desc: Explore our wide range of products to turn your dream waterpark into reality, and let's design the best solutions for your project together.

arge.title: R&D & Innovation
arge.subtitle: Future Water Entertainment Technologies
arge.desc: As the first approved R&D center in Muğla, Polgün R&D Center designs innovative technologies and products shaping the industry.
arge.section1_desc: Using engineering software, flow analyses, and next-generation production methods, we optimize the performance and durability of our products.
arge.navatu_desc: An innovative wave pool system that takes the natural wave experience to a new dimension.
arge.savana_desc: An innovative R&D project that combines four different slide paths in a single structure.
arge.monarch_desc: A custom design bringing the aesthetic form of butterfly wings together with water slide geometry, offering a high-speed and double-sided riding experience.
arge.hero_desc: At Polgün Waterparks, the foundation of our R&D approach is to develop safe, innovative, sustainable, and high-value-added water entertainment technologies.
arge.misyon_desc: To bring unique solutions to the water entertainment industry by developing high-quality, safe, cost-effective, and innovative R&D projects; and to create pioneering products that represent our country in national and international markets. We aim to bring qualified knowledge, technology, and human resources to our sector by adhering to work schedules, engineering verifications, standards compliance, and sustainable production principles in our R&D processes.
arge.vizyon_desc: As Polgün Waterparks R&D Center, our vision is to be a leading and pioneering R&D center that shapes water entertainment technologies with its unique designs, innovative engineering solutions, strong production capability, and projects in compliance with international standards. We aim to become a brand recognized both nationally and internationally with projects we develop without compromising quality.
arge.p1: Our center, which gained R&D Center status with Ministerial approval in 2021, pioneers original product development, localization, and technology production in our sector as the first and only R&D Center of Muğla.
arge.p2: In our R&D Center, we manage new product design, engineering analyses, prototyping, testing, validation, production method development, and intellectual property processes in a holistic approach with 30 full-time equivalent qualified R&D personnel working as researchers, technicians, and support staff.
arge.p3: We view nationalization and localization efforts for our country as a strategic responsibility; we develop solutions that reduce external dependency, are rapidly applicable, and directly respond to customer needs. In all our R&D processes from design to production, from analysis to field application, we adhere to the principles of safety, quality, compliance with international standards, and sustainability.
arge.p4: Projects developed at Polgün R&D Center add value to the sector in areas such as water savings, user safety, capacity increase, thematic experience, modular production, composite material technologies, and next-generation water slide geometries. Our innovative product projects such as Navatu, Savana, Monarch Butterfly, and Eclipse are among the important R&D outputs that represent Polgün's design, engineering, and production strength in the international market.
arge.p5: Our R&D activities are not limited to new product development alone. We also carry out continuous development work to improve the performance of existing products, improve production processes, reduce environmental impacts, increase material efficiency, and increase our competitive power in international markets. We strengthen our corporate knowledge base through academic collaborations, scientific publications, patent and design registration processes; and transform the outputs obtained into a sustainable innovation culture.

history.title: 四十年创新与辉煌历程
history.desc1: Polgün continuously carries out infrastructure investments to meet the increasing capacity need and advance its production capabilities; while creating new production areas for polyester, thermoplastic coating, and painting processes in its existing facilities in Muğla, it consolidates its growing operational power on an international scale by reaching a total of 120.000 m² production area with the new factory investment in Bursa.
history.desc2: In order to carry R&D and Design competence even further, the application process for the Marmara Teknokent office has been completed and the contract has been signed, officializing the structure. This setup aims to strengthen university collaborations.
history.bold_summary: Today, Polgün strengthens its position in the international market with its manufacturing setup in Turkey and sales office in Spain.

milestones.2002: Polgün started its operations in Muğla-Menteşe.
milestones.2008: First international project delivery was accomplished.
milestones.2015: Production capacity was increased and new facilities were commissioned.
milestones.2021: Ministry-approved R&D Center status was obtained — Muğla's first and only R&D Center.
milestones.2025: A total of 120,000 m² production area was reached with the Bursa factory investment.
milestones.2026: University-industry cooperation was strengthened with the Marmara Teknokent office.

aile_sosyal_hizmetler.title: Collaboration with Family and Social Services Directorate
aile_sosyal_hizmetler.desc: As the Polgün family, we are happy to support a meaningful work carried out by the Muğla Provincial Directorate of Family and Social Services. Thanks to this cooperation, which was initiated through our Governor İdris Akbıyık, warmer and safer living spaces are created for children. We believe in the power of social solidarity and adopt the importance of such contributions in every step looking to the future with hope.

iftar_programi.title: Our Traditional Iftar Invitation
iftar_programi.desc: Our traditional iftar invitation, honored by our Muğla Governor Mr. İdris Akbıyık, Menteşe District Governor Mr. Mehmet Eriş, MSKÜ Rector Prof. Dr. Turhan Kaçar, Yatağan Mayor Mr. Mesut Günay, 27th Term Muğla Deputy Mrs. Yelda Erol, TÜBİTAK MARTEK President and 24th Term Deputy Mr. Mehmet Ali Okur, valuable businesspeople of Muğla, political party representatives and our big Polgün family, took place on March 14, 2026, at Türkan Saylan Education and Culture Center with the participation of more than 600 guests. In the iftar program organized by Polgün Waterparks & Attractions Chairman of the Board İbrahim Güngör and his precious family, accompanied by hymns sung by Turkish Sufi Music artist Abdurrahman Önül, Enes Çiftçi's presentation and semazen show attracted great attention. We extend our thanks to all our family members who attended and honored our invitation.

msku_kariyer_fuari.title: MSKÜ Career Fair
msku_kariyer_fuari.desc: Polgün Waterparks & Attractions Chairman of the Board Mr. İbrahim Güngör met with the professionals of the future at the Career Fair organized at Muğla Sıtkı Koçman University. Sharing his knowledge and experience in the sector with young talents, İbrahim Güngör held an inspiring conversation with students on the dynamics of the water park and entertainment sector, our innovative projects, and career planning. The excitement and vision of the youth who will shape the future of our industry once again became a great source of motivation for us. As the Polgün family, we are proud to stand by young talents and support them in their career journeys!

custom.desc: At Polgün, every project can be turned into a unique story.
